title: fix: show the full desktop size on the Systems phone toolbar
body:
## What Problem This Solves

On a phone, choosing **Actual** in the Systems desktop viewer leaves the closed selector reading **Act…**. You have to reopen it to read the size you just chose.

## User Impact

You can read the full **Actual** label without moving any toolbar controls or changing the tap target.

## Why This Change Was Made

The compact Systems toolbar now reserves the same 28 px for the chevron as its device picker. The 88 × 32 px control, the label’s leading edge, and the toolbar’s row centers stay put. The shared desktop viewer and forced-color controls are unchanged.

## Evidence

**390 px Systems:** available text width grew from 42 to 48 px. In the captured UI, the label ink exceeded the trailing text guide by 5.30 px before the change and cleared it by 0.70 px afterward. The view-only and size controls remained centered at y = 204.39 px; the toolbar retained its two rows with no horizontal overflow.

### Clean comparison

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![The selected size reads Act…](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5331dfdc-e64d-4056-be02-572a9d52c4d3) | ![The selected size reads Actual](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2b288c6d-a65a-4d5f-96ee-d18bf63de04d) |

### Annotated comparison

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![The label is clipped within 42 px](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/314f3d2f-d5a1-4209-8f19-fa937104bf8b) | ![The full label fits within 48 px](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a2c9a7a4-5ed0-4689-a196-b661566db2c8) |

Matched 390 × 844 Chromium captures of the Systems toolbar and the synthetic view-only desktop. Before: `7b63d36f6f35`; after: `1c9944f3d3e6` (same changed files as the first published head, `6743e17b18b5`).

**First published head:** The new browser regression failed on the base (6 px short) and passed with the fix. Systems at 1440 px retained its 88 × 32 px selector; the focused desktop document at 390 px retained its 115.33 × 44 px selector. The sizing menu selected Actual, and entering and exiting fullscreen preserved the selection. The full local Systems file passed 25 of 26 tests: a separate touch-drawer check sampled opacity 0.990951 while expecting 1. Its fixture has no desktop viewer. The [hosted UI test](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44947482057/job/136978323594) and [scheduled main](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44940901144/job/136958010708) instead failed the same Settings search assertion: both returned an extra Spanish result, “Modo de código.”

**CSS-budget repair (`8f952c8317db`):** The [first head’s performance check](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44947482057/job/136978323853) failed because total raw CSS grew by 109 B against a 64 B allowance. Grouping the compact Systems selectors reduced growth to **52 B** against the local base; the targeted performance check passed. The separate 183 B largest-stylesheet warning was not the failing metric. The published tree matches the locally tested repair (`bb24284e8dbd`). Its 390 px Systems capture is byte-for-byte identical to the earlier after image, and the 1440 px Systems and focused-phone selector measurements are unchanged. These are local repair results, not a claim about [current hosted checks](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/203296/checks). No physical device, remote input, or external desktop was used.

### Verification after integrating main

All 29 Systems browser scenarios passed, including the three existing keyboard focus and reordering cases. At 390 px the selected Actual label fits before the chevron and the observed desktop remains view-only.

![Actual desktop size fits on a 390 px phone](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a984cb5a-444e-404e-90a5-6883e851197d)
